column1: # Which Wiki page was last pasted into the live Wiki.
# This is the machine-readable half of Assets/Wiki/!sync-status.md. That file
# used to record sync state only in prose ("Verified against the live Wiki on
# 2026-09-06"), which nothing could check - so when six pages had changed and
# the prose still named three, nothing noticed and the maintainer had to ask
# for a manual re-check every time.
# The HASH is the field that matters: it is the git blob hash of the exact
# bytes that were pasted. The Stop hook wiki-sync-status.sh compares each page
# against it and rewrites the waiting list. A commit SHA alone will not do -
# pages are routinely pasted while their edits are uncommitted, and comparing
# commits then reports every page as permanently stale.
# Stamped for you by .claude/hooks/wiki-mark-synced.sh when you confirm a
# paste. README.md and images/ are not Wiki pages and never appear here.
